articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin slips to fresh lows below $59,000 as Anthropic slides after Nasdaq debut
articles.snippet: BlackRock’s bitcoin ETF saw a record $541.1 million outflow as the U.S. tech selloff spread to Asia, sending South Korea’s Kospi down more than 5%.

articles.title: No special rules for Hyperliquid or other onchain trading platforms, CFTC says
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid and other onchain exchanges can offer derivatives to U.S. traders if they obtain the required licenses or work with a registered exchange, the CFTC chairman said.

articles.title: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest piled into Anthropic IPO, buying $90 million worth of shares
articles.snippet: ARK Invest snapped up $90 million in Anthropic stock across six funds during the AI maker’s historic Nasdaq debut while offloading Nvidia shares amid leadership turmoil.

articles.title: Wrapped Monero token plunges 99% as issuer-linked wallet sells $13.5 million
articles.snippet: The sell-off hit Wagyu’s XMR1 token, separate from Monero and Hyperliquid’s XMR futures market.

articles.title: Ethereum’s next big upgrade is pushed into 2027 by apps it would break
articles.snippet: Glamsterdam was originally targeted for December, but developers now say January is the earliest possible date as companies work to fix affected smart contracts.
